description: Invented loan product catalog for the GoodLeap demo. APRs and promo mechanics are illustrative, not any lender's real terms.

products.name: Fixed 5-year
products.terms: Fixed APR of 6.99% for 60 months. Equal monthly payments of principal and interest. No prepayment penalty. No origination fee in this demo.

products.name: Fixed 10-year
products.terms: Fixed APR of 7.49% for 120 months. Equal monthly payments of principal and interest. No prepayment penalty.

products.name: Fixed 15-year
products.terms: Fixed APR of 8.00% for 180 months. Equal monthly payments of principal and interest. No prepayment penalty. Paying extra toward principal shortens the term and reduces total interest.

products.name: Fixed 25-year
products.terms: Fixed APR of 9.49% for 300 months. Lowest monthly payment of the fixed products; highest total interest. No prepayment penalty.

products.name: 0% intro, 10-year
products.terms: 0% APR for the first 12 months; payments during the intro period are principal only (loan amount divided by 120). From month 13 the remaining balance accrues interest at 9.99% APR and is repaid in equal payments over the remaining 108 months. No prepayment penalty. The intro rate is not deferred interest: no interest is charged retroactively.

products.name: Deferred interest, 18-month promo
products.terms: No interest if the full balance is paid within 18 months. If any balance remains after month 18, interest at 24.99% APR is charged from the original purchase date on the full original balance, and the remaining balance is repaid over the rest of an 84-month term. Minimum monthly payments during the promo are set to pay the balance off in 18 months. No prepayment penalty.
